title: CSCI 532 — Introduction to Intelligent Security Systems
subject: Cybersecurity
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of intelligent security systems and their role in information assurance.
Explain how artificial intelligence methodologies enhance intrusion detection and monitoring capabilities.
Evaluate the design principles of firewall structures and access control mechanisms using intelligent frameworks.
